content.text:
Finding submitted.

**Deviation — § 13.1 (p0052), high severity.** The Services grant runs to "Customer alone," expressly excludes Affiliates and contractors, and is "revocable at Vendor's sole discretion" — the walk-away position under the LICENSE rule, and inconsistent with § 13.2 (Affiliates/contractors covered for paid-up material) and § 13.3 (revocation only for uncured material breach; transfer to Affiliate or successor permitted).

**Redline (validated, preferred level):** grant extended to "Customer, its Affiliates, and contractors acting on Customer's behalf," with revocation/suspension and transfer rights tied to the limits already agreed in § 13.3 — a single-sentence edit that leverages the existing bargain rather than adding new terms. Fallback (Affiliate coverage on written notice) flagged in the comment.
